articles.title: Wilkey announces 2026 campaign for Precinct 3, Place 2 Justice of the Peace
articles.excerpt: Wilkey retired from the Temple Police Department on June 22, 2022 and was sworn into office on June 23, 2022; his precinct covers Little River-Academy, Rogers, Temple and Troy (Nov. 26, 2025).

articles.title: Bell County primary ballot features several uncontested races
articles.excerpt: Wilkey is the only candidate for Precinct 3, Place 2 in 2026, unopposed in the Republican primary and the general election (Feb. 14, 2026).
